title: fix: worktree session files fail to open with "Session workspace changed during file read"
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: files in a project worktree session fail to open in the side panel or Files panel with `Session workspace changed during file read`, even when nothing about the session has changed.

## User Impact

User impact: HTML previews and other files from worktree-backed sessions open again in the Control UI. Sessions without a worktree were not affected.

## Why This Change Was Made

`sessions.files.list` and `sessions.files.get` re-read the session after waiting for sandbox settlement, to refuse the read if the session was reset or moved to a different worktree in the meantime. Since #169757, that re-read used the logical session store path, which the retained-facts reader does not recognize, so it always came back empty and every worktree read was refused. The re-read now uses the session's captured read source, the same way the other retained-facts callers do. The safety check itself is unchanged.

## Evidence

Real Gateway (isolated test instance), real project worktree session created with `sessions.create`, Control UI in Chromium, clicking an assistant link to `halloween-theme/preview.html`:

Before (current `main` code):

![Before: the preview tab shows "Error: Session workspace changed during file read"](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/98b72b2b-2032-4d24-80cc-edacb3dcade8)

After (this PR):

![After: the same link opens the rendered HTML preview](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d824fa7c-a0c0-49f3-9308-bd4403622074)

- New `src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-files.worktree.test.ts` (real SQLite session storage and Gateway handlers):
  - reads files from a worktree session: fails on `main` with `Session workspace changed during file read`, passes with this change.
  - refuses the read when the session moves to another worktree during settlement: passes, so the guard still works.
- Neighboring `sessions-files` suites: 6 files, 89 tests passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` and the gateway test typecheck shards passed; `oxfmt --check` clean.

The browser proof used a temporary real-Gateway Control UI spec that is not part of this PR; the Gateway-level test above is the regression coverage.

Reported by @Patrick-Erichsen.
